title: Applicability of Article VI, Chapter 4
previewText: Notwithstanding the general provisions of Section 135-01, in flood zones, in the event of a conflict between the provisions of this Chapter and the provisions of Article VI, Chapter 4 (Special Regulations Applying in Flood Zones), the provisions of Article VI, Chapter 4 shall control.
